name: phaseSecs
meaning: designer properties at prop offsets 0x18/0x1c/0x20, kept as bytes (PostLoadInit 0x44ee18-0x44ee6c). SetState(9) reads phaseSecs[hitIndex+1] (0x450b89 movzx byte [ecx+eax+0x7d]), so entry 0 is never used and hitIndex 2 reads past the array into state (+0x7f)

name: state
meaning: GossamerBossState; switch subject of Update (0x44f3bf movzx byte [eax+0x7f]) and of SetState (0x45079d)

name: prevState
meaning: previous state saved by SetState (0x45078b mov byte [eax+0x80] dl)

name: pathIndex
meaning: index into path->pts, advanced by msg 0x43 (0x45057e add al,1) and read by the return step (0x451217 movzx byte [edx+0x81]; imul 6)

name: shakeTicks
meaning: frames spent in state 0xc; the ground shake fires on the 0x14th (0x450141 movzx byte [eax+0x82]; cmp 0x14)

name: hitIndex
meaning: phase counter: 0xffff at Init/Reset (0x44f069), +1 per msg 0x43 (0x45050a add ax,1); indexes phaseBoxes[] (0x44f98f) and phaseSecs[hitIndex+1]

name: phaseOverlapX
meaning: pos.x - phaseBoxes[hitIndex]->max.x when the last phase box is left (0x44f9a2)

name: turnAccum
meaning: turn accumulated by TurnStep in 4096ths (0x451e8c); compared with turnNeeded (0x451f5f)

name: turnRefAngle
meaning: reference heading for TurnStep, facing - 0x800 (0x451985, 0x44f401)

name: turnDir
meaning: +1 / -1 sense of the current turn (0x451dab, 0x451db9)

name: turnDirLatch
meaning: turnDir latched on the first frame of a turn; a reversal aborts the turn (0x451e01-0x451e14)

name: spinFacing
meaning: facing saved when state 8 starts (0x450ace) and restored every frame of it (0x44fadb)

name: wolfDist
meaning: XZ distance to Ralph, refreshed at the top of Update (0x44f3a8); unsigned in every compare (0x44f45c ja, 0x450314 jae)

name: timerMs
meaning: state timer in ms; += g_dtMs (0x44f4b8)

name: timerLimitMs
meaning: limit for timerMs (0x44f44e cmp)

name: facingDelta
meaning: |Ralph's facing - the boss's facing| wrapped to <= 3000, written by UpdateFacingDelta (0x452200)

name: spinDurationMs
meaning: copy of timerLimitMs kept for the dust column's frame selector (0x450bbe, 0x44fe4e)

name: turnNeeded
meaning: total turn a TurnStep must accumulate: 0x800 / 0x1000 / 0x3000 by state (0x4507bb, 0x4509a9, 0x450ad8)

name: wolfHeld
meaning: reply to Ralph's freeze message 0xe; msg 0xf releases him (0x45060c)

name: showHitBody
meaning: hitBody is rendered and animated while set (0x44f2e6)

name: chasingFlat
meaning: set when Ralph has been flattened; the chase step then polls msg 0x41c (0x4519b0)

name: smashStarted
meaning: state 0xb: the smash animation has been launched (0x44ff06)

name: hasChaseTarget
meaning: non-zero while chaseTarget is valid (msg 0x42 arg +0x1c4); switches states 0x11/0x12 (0x452053)

name: caughtWolf
meaning: set when state 0xe starts within 100 units of Ralph (msg 0x41d); decides state 0x12 vs 0x10 (0x450111)

name: pathShifted
meaning: one-shot: the path points are shifted by the msg 0x43 argument only once (0x45051b)

name: showSpinBody
meaning: spinBody is rendered while set (0x44f30b)

name: toTarget
meaning: target - pos each frame (0x45193f)

name: velocity
meaning: units per second for this frame (0x451ad6)

name: frameDelta
meaning: Vec3s_ScaleByDt(velocity): the move applied this frame (0x451b21)

name: spawnPos
meaning: position at the start of the fight; Reset puts the boss back there (0x451730)

name: fxOrigin
meaning: dust-column origin: pos with the vertical raised 0xdc (0x450b40)

name: fxAnchor
meaning: fxOrigin pushed 100 units away from the camera through fxFrame (0x44fc8f-0x44fd35)

name: arenaMaxSave
meaning: arenaBox->max as loaded; Reset restores it (0x44f0da)

name: arenaMinSave
meaning: arenaBox->min as loaded; Reset restores it (0x44f11f)

name: homePos
meaning: the point the boss walks back to (path point, or its position at Reset) (0x4505a7, 0x4518b8)

name: fallStep
meaning: per-frame fall/slide vector of the knock-back, and the landing spot handed to SetPosition (0x4510e3, 0x451114)

name: fxFrame
meaning: fixed quarter-turn about the vertical used to offset the dust column toward the camera; rot[4] is set to 1 rather than 0x1000 (0x44f1b1) but multiplies the always-zero vertical, and trans is never initialised

name: fx
meaning: 3-slot dust column driven by Emitter_UpdateColumn (0x44fe81); an inline-storage emitter (0x60 bytes): the factory's inline constructor (0x44ec1b) points slotPool at +0x14c (0x44ec29) and particles at +0x170 (0x44ec37)

name: fxParams
meaning: Emitter_UpdateColumn parameter block of the dust column: riseSpeed 0, life 1000, period 1000, size 0x40 to 0x40, sheet 7 (stored field by field at 0x44ef93-0x44efd2)

name: soundHandle
meaning: channel handle of the spin / impact sound (0x44fb44)

name: path
meaning: PROPERTY at offset 0x14 (Scn_GetPropTrajectory 0x44ee94): the walk-back points

name: hitBody
meaning: extra body built from export 0x95 (0x44f00b); drawn at the boss position while showHitBody

name: spinBody
meaning: extra body built from export 0xd8 (0x44f051); drawn at fxOrigin while showSpinBody

name: bodyRecord
meaning: scratch record shared by the two Scn_BuildRecordFromExport calls (0x44eff4)

name: camSetup
meaning: CamSetup: focal = CAMERA property word 0; the whole 16-byte block is overwritten by *camProp in the last phase (0x4514de); rot = CAMERA rotation handed to Camera_StartScripted (0x4516f6); eye = CAMERA eye handed to Camera_StartScripted (0x4516e5); pad = tail padding of the 16-byte camera block copied at 0x4514ee

name: camProp
meaning: PROPERTY CAMERA at offset 0 (Scn_GetPropCamera 0x44ef65 returns a CamSetup *)

name: phaseBoxes
meaning: PROPERTY boxes at offsets 4/8/0xc (0x44ece2-0x44ed10): one arena box per phase

name: arenaBox
meaning: PROPERTY box at offset 0x10 (0x44ee7d): the fight arena

name: modelBox
meaning: the model's first collision box (inst_model->boxes->boxes, 0x44eec4); widened while the boss falls

name: modelBoxSave
meaning: modelBox min/max as loaded; Reset restores them (0x44eeda-0x44ef4d)

name: smashBoxes
meaning: copies of *phaseBoxes[i] with min.x and max.x shifted by -(5000+i) (0x44ed57); tested by IsInSmashBox

name: onde
meaning: the level's GossamerOnde (class 0xb6) from Scenaric_FindByClass (0x44ef88); polled with msg 0x6c during the smash

name: chaseTarget
meaning: msg 0x42 arg: the sender's +0x1c0 pointer, chased in state 0x11 (0x450747)
